# Negative control matrix: target <TAB> mutant <TAB> description.
# Run by `./build.sh mutants`. Every row must make the target's `--generate`
# run fail with an AddressSanitizer report, a UBSan runtime error or a
# post-condition failure. A row that stops being detected means the harness
# has stopped checking that property, which is a finding in the harness — not
# a reason to delete the row.
# Each target carries two rows: one memory-safety mutation, which proves the
# exact-size allocation and ASan are wired up, and one semantic mutation,
# which proves the post-conditions are doing work of their own. Without the
# second kind, a harness that only allocated correctly would look healthy.
# Frequency (Issue #67): on harness addition, on infra change, and nightly.
